-- Integer square root: the largest r with r * r <= n.
-- Spec only: the body is filled in during Phase 2.
isqrt(n: int) -> int =
  pre n >= 0
  post out * out <= n and n < (out + 1) * (out + 1)
  ex isqrt(0) == 0
  ex isqrt(15) == 3
  ex isqrt(16) == 4
  var lo = 0
  var hi = n // 2 + 1
  while lo < hi
    let mid = lo + (hi - lo + 1) // 2
    if mid <= n // mid
      lo = mid
    else
      hi = mid - 1
  lo

test_isqrt() =
  assert isqrt(0) == 0
  assert isqrt(1) == 1
  assert isqrt(15) == 3
  assert isqrt(16) == 4
  assert isqrt(17) == 4
